update staff_pay_personnel_slip set delete_flag = 1 where staff_pay_slip_id = #{staffPaySlipId,jdbcType=BIGINT}
mapper.insert: insert into survey_pay_info (pay_no, app_pay_money, app_start_date, app_end_date, pay_state, create_user_id, create_time, create_by, delete_flag, pay_type, user_id, real_name, staff_personnel_id, social_security_company_id, social_security_company, organ_id, organ, department_id, department, team_id, team, pay_key_id, job_post_id,job_post) select * from ( select CONCAT('GZ',(NOW() + (@a :=@a + 1))), p.real_wages, now() as startDate, now() as endDate, 1 as payState, #{currUserId,jdbcType=BIGINT} as createUserId, now() as createTime, #{currUserName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as createBy, 0 as deleteFlag, 4 as payType, p.user_id as userId, p.real_name as realName, p.staff_personnel_id, p.social_security_company_id, p.social_security_company, p.organ_id, p.organ, p.department_id, p.department, p.team_id, p.team, p.id, p.job_post_id, p.job_post from staff_pay_personnel_slip p,(SELECT @a := 0) a where p.staff_pay_slip_id = #{staffPaySlipId,jdbcType=BIGINT} and p.delete_flag = 0 ) a

insert into survey_pay_info_detail_new (pay_id, opr_id, opr_code) select * from ( select i.id as payId,p.id as oprId,"slip" as oprCode from staff_pay_personnel_slip p left join survey_pay_info i on p.id = i.pay_key_id where p.staff_pay_slip_id = #{staffPaySlipId,jdbcType=BIGINT} and i.pay_type = 4 ) a
